text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Blast-san, happy birthday. Is there 
anything you want for a present?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really!? Waaaah! Thank you, Urara~~! 
Umm, see ya later, then~~!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Boo wants to go out together with Lala!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Are you sure that's all? I do 
that kinda stuff all the time, so since 
we're at it, why not ask for something 
fancier—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Nope! I wanna play with Lala! Lala is 
always so calm and reassuring, and that's 
why I loooove you so much!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I want to go to all kinds of places! First 
off~ let's eat cake at the shop by the 
station!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
And then, let's check out the new arrivals 
at the select shop! I wanna hear your 
recommendations again, Lara! It'll be a 
fitting room fashion show!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Let's train, and make carrot cookies too! 
Whenever Boo is with Lara, it's waaaay 
more fun and suuuuper exciting!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(She's way too cute! Just how excited is 
she to play with me... Aaargh, I just 
wanna ruffle her hair all over!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—If that's the case, by all means. I look 
forward to working with you, Blast-san.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Waaaah! Yay, yay, yaaaay!! Thank 
you, Lala! I love you so muuuuch!!
